paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in Yoma 18a and Tosefta Zavim, chapter 2, speaking in the name of Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira. In [Jerusalem Talmud] Sotah 1:2 he is mentioned in the dispute over the measure of seclusion, after Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira; but in the Babylonian Sotah 4a the reading there is Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah. He is also mentioned in the work abbreviated בכ״ר, end of chapter 37.

notes.text: The supplied בכ״ר at the end of chapter 37 remains literal. The matching Bereshit Rabbah 37:8 witness is an explicit comparison, not proof of a printed correction history.
The consulted Yoma passage names Elazar ben Pinchas reporting Yehudah ben Beteira. Sotah has Elazar ben Yirmeyah. The consulted Bereshit Rabbah 37:8 also names Elazar ben Pinchas.
